'''Texture-molding tractor fields''' were used in the creation of [[molecularly bonded armor]]. The [[tractor field]]s held dense [[Metal/Legends|metals]] in place, then the metal was softened and liquified by [[ion fuser]]s. As the resulting alloy cooled, it was bombarded by [[charged-particle vibrating wave]]s which strengthened its molecular subatomic bond strength.<ref name="EGWT" />
